title: Batching throughput rhythm and p95/p99 guardrails for per-route/model/region
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Add an observability and regression-detection workflow that correlates tokens/sec (throughput), batching rhythm, and p95/p99 latency slices across route/model/region. This ticket builds a sampled telemetry pipeline + dashboard and an automated guardrail service that flags and annotates regressions caused by batching changes, kernel selection, or KV cache behavior. Deliverables: 1) sampled tokens/sec and batch-size histograms per route/model/region; 2) p95 and p99 tracked as rolling baselines and change detectors with contextual metadata (batch size, KV cache hit rate, model variant); 3) dashboard with sliceable heatmaps and a single-pane-of-glass alert view; 4) synthetic load harness improvements to reproduce regressions locally and in CI; 5) regression alerting rules and playbook that surface likely root causes and suggested mitigations.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry emits tokens_per_sec, avg_batch_size, batch_variance, kv_cache_hit_rate per request with route/model/region tags
p95 and p99 time-series computed and stored with 1m and 5m rollups and accessible by route/model/region
Dashboard available in Console showing: throughput vs p95/p99, batch-size distribution, KV hit overlays, and heatmap drilldowns
Automatic regression detector creates an incident when p95 or p99 deviates beyond configurable thresholds compared to the rolling baseline and attaches top correlated signals
Synthetic harness can replay sampled traffic and reproduce the flagged regression within CI with <10% variance
Playbook document linked from alert includes suggested mitigations: reduce max_batch, switch kernel variant, fall back to smaller sequence length model

tasks: Instrument runtime to emit sampled batch-size histograms and tokens/sec per request (5% sampling target)
Add kv_cache_hit_rate and kernel_variant tags to telemetry
Build quantile rollup job (1m/5m) and storage mapping keyed by route/model/region
Create dashboard with throughput vs quantiles, batch distribution, and drilldown heatmap
Implement regression detector service and integrate with incidents (attach top correlated signals)
Extend synthetic load harness to capture replay fidelity and add CI job
Write alert playbook and remediation suggestions, include canary rollback steps
risks_and_open_questions: Telemetry cost vs fidelity tradeoff: do we need dynamic sampling tied to traffic spike detection?
False positives: how to avoid noisy alerts during scheduled deploys or warmup periods? Consider deploy-safe windows and tagging
Correlation vs causation: KV hit-rate can covary with load; detector should surface likely suspects but not automatically apply remedies
Rollouts: should we gate detector tuning behind runtime-1.19 canary?
Security: route-level filters must respect tenant isolation for private deployments
implementation_notes: Use histogram sketch (HDR or DDSketch) for batch-size distribution to bound storage cost
Store quantile rollups in existing TSDB with new metric namespace: rw.quantiles.{route}.{model}.{region}
Regression detection uses both relative and absolute thresholds; use 7d baseline with weekly seasonality smoothing
Dashboard will leverage existing console visualization components; heatmap tile is custom but reuses color scale utilities
Synthetic harness: capture representative prefix tokens/sec distribution, and replay with original timing + jitter to reproduce batching interactions
